stemMd: An invoice includes 20% tax and totals €216. What was the price before tax?
explanationMd: If the pre-tax price is p, the total is 1.20p. Therefore p = 216/1.20 = 180. Checking 20% of 180 gives 36, and 180 + 36 = 216. Reverse a percentage increase by division, not subtraction from the final value.

distractorRationale.c: This removes 20% of the tax-inclusive price rather than reversing the multiplier.
distractorRationale.e: This subtracts the percentage as if it were a currency amount.
distractorRationale.d: This does not produce €216 after adding 20%.
distractorRationale.b: This adds the tax a second time.
